title: Logsytech Group
description: logsytech.fr Logsytech Group is a French logistics holding company based in Émerainville near Paris, founded in 2001 and acquired by D-Groupe Logistique in December 2022. With 160 employees, 7 warehouses totaling 30,000 square meters and 4 million shipments per year, it provides e-commerce, telecom, IoT and marketing logistics services. Its six subsidiaries cover Optilog for e-commerce, Mecalog for telecom equipment, ARC for point-of-sale advertising logistics, Optiaustral for Reunion Island distribution and Logsys for in-house IT solutions. Major clients include SFR, TotalEnergies, Weight Watchers, La Française des Jeux and Recommerce. The group runs its own WMS, ERP and TMS software with real-time tracking and a call center handling 3,000 calls per day. Combined with D-Groupe, the entity generates 100 million euro in revenue with 600 staff.
